facts.fact: 争吵后 George 发难逼她吃下带汁的饭——他自己「对洋葱过敏」（她怀疑只是挑食夸张）；她为这顿午饭连早饭都没吃。
facts.anchor: He’s allergic to onions – or so he says. Personally, I think he just doesn’t like them, and he is being a tad dramatic

facts.fact: Maria 再次叫错名字——这回是 Bianca，后面还换成 Becca。
她说辞职是「您儿子的天才主意」，他夸她「注定成大事」。
facts.anchor: Actually, it was your son’s genius idea.’ I point my fork in his direction. ‘He said I’m destined for greater things.’

facts.fact: 「自雇」这个说法是 George 教她的标准答案——任何人问起都这么答。
facts.anchor: Because that’s what he told me to say if anyone ever asked me.

facts.fact: 她 16 岁起就拼命打工养活自己，什么活都干过。
facts.anchor: from the week I turned sixteen, I’ve worked my backside off. I’ve done every job imaginable to make sure I could support myself.

facts.fact: 破碎家庭教会她：最亲的人给的帮助也会连本带利抢回去——她妈就是这样。
facts.anchor: even the people closest to you might offer you help and then snatch it back, demanding interest.

facts.fact: 他以「不忍心你被醉汉调戏」为由不许她上夜班，不接受拒绝。
facts.anchor: he wouldn’t feel comfortable with me being wolf-whistled at by drunken men if we were to be together. He wouldn’t take no for an answer

facts.fact: 她表面零反应，脑内却幻想抓着 Maria 的头发按进微波炉、端上 George 的盘子。
facts.anchor: I’m imagining grabbing her hair, shoving this witches head into the microwave and serving her on George’s plate instead.
